text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I overheard you, but... don't 
misunderstand. 
There's no 'stage' for me here."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Nonsense! If you so desire, I shall 
invoke the power of the Golden Ring for 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Joking around again, as always... Even if 
I wanted to help, I'm not registered on 
your team."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, but you are! I took the liberty of 
adding you as an alternate member!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"There's an outfit for you, too. I already 
requested one from the Chairwoman!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "What, wait... Wh-When did you...?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah-hahaha! I had a hunch that bringing 
in a hero to save the day in a pinch would 
make the stage so much more dramatic! You 
could call it visionary foresight!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And if I had to choose one final member, 
it could only be you, Ayabe-san! For we 
are rivals who compete, elevate one 
another, and sometimes join hands!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, you were drawn to Doto's wish 
to 'make everyone happy' too, weren't you? 
The fact that you are standing here is 
proof enough!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Ayabe-san, are you sure about this? 
You're not forcing yourself, are you...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"You said you wanted to focus on your 
races right now, didn't you, Ayabe-san...? 
Isn't this... an imposition on you...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's fine. It's my decision...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I saw how hard you were trying. 
In that case... I can hardly walk away, 
can I?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Doto...

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the finals of the All-Japan 
Umamusume Karuta Tournament are about to 
begin! Both teams have finished their 
memorization time with tense expressions."

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, huh? Tracen Academy made a roster 
change? They swapped positions, too... 
Guess the rumors about an injury were true 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I'm willing to lend a hand, but under one 
condition. 
...Doto and Opera O swap roles."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Running is running, but races and karuta 
are different. You've been the taker the 
whole time without resting—you're at your 
physical limit, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...As expected, nothing escapes your gaze.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"B-But if we're swapping with Opera O-san, 
wouldn't you be a better fit than me, 
Ayabe-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Taking the win... taking everyone's 
happiness into your hands—that's your 
role, Doto."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "...! Y-Yeeees!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone... *ugh*, *cough*, *hack*! 
Please... play without any regreds...!"

text_block_list.name: Reader Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Umamusume... upon the cliff—"

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Got it!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(So fast! Or rather, is everyone on our 
side moving stiffly...? 
W-Well, of course, we're basically an 
impromptu team...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Uuu... I'm so useless... This is 
pathetic! 
At such a crucial moment, I can't even 
cheer them on...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... please, please... just get 
that first card...!)

text_block_list.name: Reader Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Only the sound of hooves rings out in 
the dawn. 
On this bright, peaceful spring day—"
Here I gooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! <New Year's Super Great Luck Kitaru> takes one back! 
I believe this is the first time in this 
tournament she's gone on the offensive!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaay! Fuku-chaaan, I did it! 
It's the 'So majestic, the cherry blossom 
buds' card!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I had decided I was definitely 
going to get this poem!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
(To honestly cherish your own desire to 
win— 
Urara-san taught me that...!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Urara-zaaan! Everyoooone! 
One card! Cherish every single caaard!! 
Win thiiis, pleaaase!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto! Attack, right 3-5!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes'm~~!! One card, I'll cherish it with 
all my might~~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Urara-san, screen! Back Doto up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll clear the way for Doto-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by that last card, they 
continue their furious advance! 
Team <New Year's Super Great Luck Kitaru>—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, far left!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You can make it!! Run!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We... won't lose... We'll all win 
together... and together—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We'll make this a super happy-come-come 
year for all of uuuus!!!

text_block_list.name: Karuta Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Match over!! The champions of this year's 
All-Japan Umamusume Karuta Tournament are 
none other than the first-time entrants 
from Tracen Academy, <New Year's Super Great Luck Kitaru>!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, in front of the shrine—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right everyone, are you ready!? We're 
going to report the tournament results to 
the gods and pray for massive good luck~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... To think I'd be dragged 
along even for the prayer of thanks...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural! It would be unthinkable 
for the star of such a brilliant finale to 
miss the curtain call!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right... Ayabe-san encouraged us 
and even prepared the karuta books for 
us...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for you, Ayabe-san... 
We surely could never have won!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can I ring the bell now? Can I 
rattle it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, Urara-san, please wait a moment! 
Come on, everyone line up, line up! Let's 
greet the gods together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
O God~ Shiraoki-sama~! Just as your divine 
message instructed, we took on a 'contest 
with our friends'~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Working together with everyone was s-so 
much fun. We want to keep doing our best 
together from now on. S-So—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text:
Please, let this year be another wonderful 
year for us—!
